Arthur looked past the crashing breakers toward the grey Atlantic, a quiet warmth blooming against the winter chill.", "w02": "凌晨四点，整座城市沉入最深沉的梦乡。浓重夜色笼罩着鳞次栉比的高楼，只有几盏橘黄的路灯在雾气里静默伫立。空旷的主干道上偶尔驶过一辆环卫车，细微的刷洗声反衬出整片街区的岑寂。便利店透出一角温暖的光晕，收银员正低头整理货架。清冽的空气里弥漫着泥土与柏油的气息，黎明仍在积蓄破晓的力量。", "w03": "- Recursion is like facing two mirrors: you see smaller and smaller copies of yourself repeating over and over.\n- In computer programs, it means a task solves a problem by asking a tinier version of itself to do part of the work.\n- To avoid repeating forever, it must have a simple stopping point where it finally answers without asking again."}
